newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis says open for strategic moves.
newsitem.headline: Novartis says open for strategic moves.

text.p: Novartis AG Chief Executive Daniel Vasella said the company would consider strategic moves to strengthen core businesses but said the goal was not simply to build market share.

"We are open in all three fields to make strategic moves and we have the fantastic situation where we have the money, which give us this flexibility," he said in response to a question at the International Management Symposium.
But he added the company formed by the merger last year of Sandoz AG and Ciba-Geigy AG was not forced to make moves to build market share.
"That is precisely the reason we did this merger -- not to be forced to do anything. We wanted to be proactive," he said.
"I believe that the competition is rather being played at a therapeutic or even disease area rather than overall market share. Overall market share does not tell you the whole story," he said.
